fieldValues.title: Tasks live as issues
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Tasks are recorded as issues carrying a resolution, an owner, a due date and a project; a task record type is added only when meeting minutes need to record a task allocation as data.
fieldValues.rationale: Issues already carry what a task needs. Cites the principle One way over carrying the old one: no parallel task record until a case requires it.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a session or the decision logger needs to record a task allocation as data.
